benchmarks.name: Microsoft AI held-out Code — bits per byte
benchmarks.description: Microsoft AI internal pre-training evaluation 'Held-Out Code (MAI's codebase)': bits per byte on held-out text (tokenizer-agnostic; lower is better). Code set = MAI's own codebase. Decontaminated against MAI training data. Source: 'Frontier Pre-training at Microsoft AI' (MAI-Base-2 report, Oct 2026), Figure 1. Post-trained checkpoints (MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL, Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B, Kimi K3) are compared with base models with the vendor's caveat that post-training may affect BPB.

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Search Index
benchmarks.description: Equal-weighted mean of DeepSearchQA avg F1 (full 900-row eval split), BrowseComp exact-answer accuracy (hard 200-sample subset) and AA-Omniscience accuracy (600 held-out questions), 0-100. Each Search API powers web_search for the same candidate model GPT-5.6 Luna (medium) in the same harness (up to 25 turns, ≤10 results per call). Source: Artificial Analysis Search API leaderboard (artificialanalysis.ai/agents/search-api), data as of 2026-10-19.

benchmarks.name: AA Search Index — DeepSearchQA avg F1
benchmarks.description: DeepSearchQA LLM-graded F1 over answer items (900 rows) with the Search API as the only search tool (candidate model GPT-5.6 Luna medium). Source: Artificial Analysis Search API leaderboard (artificialanalysis.ai/agents/search-api), data as of 2026-10-19.

benchmarks.name: AA Search Index — BrowseComp accuracy
benchmarks.description: BrowseComp exact-answer accuracy on a hard 200-sample subset, Search API as the search tool (candidate model GPT-5.6 Luna medium). Source: Artificial Analysis Search API leaderboard (artificialanalysis.ai/agents/search-api), data as of 2026-10-19.

benchmarks.name: AA Search Index — AA-Omniscience accuracy
benchmarks.description: AA-Omniscience accuracy on 600 held-out factual questions, Search API as the search tool (candidate model GPT-5.6 Luna medium). Source: Artificial Analysis Search API leaderboard (artificialanalysis.ai/agents/search-api), data as of 2026-10-19.

benchmarks.name: AA Search Index — lift over model-only baseline
benchmarks.description: Search Index minus the model-only (no search) GPT-5.6 Luna (medium) baseline, in index points. Source: Artificial Analysis Search API leaderboard (artificialanalysis.ai/agents/search-api), data as of 2026-10-19.

benchmarks.name: AA Search Index — Search API cost per 1,000 tasks
benchmarks.description: Search API list-price cost per 1,000 benchmark tasks for the searches the candidate model chose to run. Source: Artificial Analysis Search API leaderboard (artificialanalysis.ai/agents/search-api), data as of 2026-10-19.

benchmarks.name: AA Search Index — candidate model cost per 1,000 tasks
benchmarks.description: Candidate model (GPT-5.6 Luna medium) token cost per 1,000 tasks when using this Search API (search results inflate input tokens). Source: Artificial Analysis Search API leaderboard (artificialanalysis.ai/agents/search-api), data as of 2026-10-19.

benchmarks.name: AA Search Index — Search API price per 1,000 queries
benchmarks.description: Search API list price per 1,000 search queries. Source: Artificial Analysis Search API leaderboard (artificialanalysis.ai/agents/search-api), data as of 2026-10-19.

benchmarks.name: AA Search Index — time per task
benchmarks.description: Derived model time + measured search time per benchmark task (OpenAI Web Search time is an upper bound incl. OpenAI processing). Source: Artificial Analysis Search API leaderboard (artificialanalysis.ai/agents/search-api), data as of 2026-10-19.

benchmarks.name: AA Search Index — time per search query
benchmarks.description: Average Search API response time for one query. Source: Artificial Analysis Search API leaderboard (artificialanalysis.ai/agents/search-api), data as of 2026-10-19.

benchmarks.name: AA Search Index — search queries per task
benchmarks.description: Average web_search calls the candidate model makes per task (averaged over the 3 benchmarks). Source: Artificial Analysis Search API leaderboard (artificialanalysis.ai/agents/search-api), data as of 2026-10-19.

benchmarks.name: AA Search Index — candidate model tokens per task
benchmarks.description: Average input + reasoning + answer tokens of the candidate model per task (grader tokens excluded). Source: Artificial Analysis Search API leaderboard (artificialanalysis.ai/agents/search-api), data as of 2026-10-19.
